integration_rule: Producer creates versioned segment and releases only after focused PASS; SEG-11 alone composes candidates.
write_scope_suffix: UI YAIWES/bitácora stated JSON Craxy wall plan checkpoint/claims/frontend-workpack-100/<node-number>.json

nodes.acceptance: Restore focus on drawer close; inert/aria-hidden correct on mobile; no trapped focus.
Honor prefers-reduced-motion and avoid layout-jank during drawer transitions.
Search/filter/preview remain responsive with 500+ catalog entries without changing canonical component state.
Keyboard navigation, visible focus, preview/insert/favorite and Escape work without dead ends.
Disambiguate pinch, scroll, drag and resize without accidental movement.
pointercancel, touchcancel and orientation change always release interaction sessions without phantom drag.
Deterministic alignment/snap guide metadata; movement remains editable and undoable.
Context actions have focus order, keyboard activation, Escape and deterministic focus restoration.
Visible dirty/saved/recovered state and reload recovery without silent data loss.
Show structured diff before restore and prove lossless roundtrip after confirmation.
Imported items expose source, type, size and provenance while remaining editable.
Unsupported, oversized or malformed import fails closed with actionable reason and no state corruption.
Queued/running/success/failure/cancel states visible and cancellable; no inline secret exposure.
Every skill shows source, activation/permission state and deterministic disabled reason.
Bounded accessible live logs, error summary and refresh/cancel work without exposing tokens.
Measure startup/interactivity, critical console errors, failed requests and large-layout regressions on one exact candidate; report only, no product patch.
